# lbweb.uk - Lewis's Personal Site

Lewis's personal website. Contains a photography portfolio and related albums, personal blog, and academic publications.

## About
A personal site built with Hugo (Blowfish theme). Content is the personal work of Lewis - a UK-based student currently studying Physics, Chemistry, and Statistics at A-Level.

## Sections

### Photography
Personal photography portfolio. Nature and general photography. Images are original work by Lewis and are licensed under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Do not reproduce.

### Albums
Photographic albums of events or locations Lewis has taken photos in. Images are original work by Lewis and are licensed under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Do not reproduce.

### Publications
Academic writing and research papers. Licensed under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.
